title: The Midas Touch
h1: Gold Luxury Charcuterie Board (The Midas Touch)
seo_title: Gold Luxury Charcuterie Board: Caviar, Jamón & Gold Leaf
description: The Midas Touch board for 12 to 15: jamón serrano, prosciutto di Parma, smoked salmon, caviar, triple-crème and 24-month Parmigiano, finished with edible gold.
hook: The most luxurious board in the book: everything is ordinary to buy, and the gold is the magic.

items.name: Edible gold leaf and edible gold luster dust

why: Jamón serrano, prosciutto di Parma, smoked salmon and a little domestic caviar come from regular stores, and a triple-crème, 24-month Parmigiano and truffle cheese make the cheese course. Edible gold leaf and luster dust are what turn it into a showpiece.
On a black marble slab, the gold catches the light. It's built for milestone birthdays, anniversaries, engagement parties and New Year's Eve.

timeline.what: Chill the champagne and the caviar (in the coldest part of the fridge, unopened). Buy the bread and toast the crostini.
Gild the cheese and the honeycomb. Break the Parmigiano into chunks.
Build the board, saving the caviar, the honey and the burrata for last.
Open the caviar, set it on ice, and pour the river of truffle honey.

faq.q: Where do you buy edible gold leaf?
faq.a: Baking supply stores and online. Make sure it's labeled food-grade edible gold, not craft gold.
About $250 to $350 for 12 to 15 people, mostly for the jamón, caviar and cheeses.

Prepare everything except the gold the day before. Apply the gold leaf just before serving. Keep meat, cheese and cut fruit out no more than 2 hours, or 1 hour above 90°F. For a long party, build half, keep the refill in the fridge and top it up halfway through.
